car.name: Alchemilla 1988
car.description: An ochre and teal mid-engine hillclimb coupe honoring Ari Vatanen and the 1988 Pikes Peak overall win. Original 2994 competition homage, not a road 405 or Dakar car; event-day setup is not verified.
